title: AI DnD Art Generator
summary: Make DnD art with AI: character portraits, monsters, taverns, battle maps and tokens for your campaign. Describe it, pick a style, and generate. Free to try.
body_markdown:
### What is the best AI art generator for DnD?


A good DnD AI art generator follows long, detailed descriptions of race, class and gear, keeps a character the same across images, and makes portraits, maps and tokens alike; in Flick, GPT Image 2.6 made every still on this page from one written prompt each.


### How do I make a DnD character portrait with AI?


Describe the character's race, class, age and gear, add one detail that shows their personality, such as a scar or a habit, name a single light source, and ask for a painterly fantasy illustration with no text or signature.


### Can AI make DnD battle maps?


Yes. Ask for a top-down view with a square grid, no perspective, no characters and no labels, and describe the rooms, doors, hazards and light; check the grid before play, since the squares do not always line up with the walls.


### How do I keep my character the same across images?


Make one portrait first, then add it as a reference image to every new scene and describe the same face, hair and gear in each prompt; GPT Image 2.6 takes up to 10 reference images.


### Can I make tokens for a virtual tabletop?


Yes. Ask for a round portrait inside a ring frame on a plain flat background, framed at head and shoulders, with strong rim light, so the face still reads when the token is shrunk onto a battle map.


### Is the DnD AI art generator free?


Yes, it is free to start: the free plan gives 100 credits every day with no credit card, and GPT Image 2.6 costs 5 credits an image. To animate a still, choose Auto in the image to video node and Flick picks the video model.
